description: Bank statement lines still waiting to be filed, each with its line_id, the suggestion GetAccountED made (account, invoice or rule) and candidate open items: unpaid customer invoices (money in) or unpaid supplier bills (money out) matching by amount or name. Amounts in rand. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

direction.description: Money in, money out or all (default all)

from.description: Only lines on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: Only lines on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: accounting_unfiled_bank_lines
title: Bank lines still to file
